I'd like to discuss https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627 - the `produceBlockV4WithBid` Beacon API endpoint - on the CL breakout. Implementation-wise it should be simple and 2 POC implementations already exist (Lodestar, Lighthouse). I've been [proposing blocks](https://dora.glamsterdam-devnet-8.ethpandaops.io/slots/filtered?f=&f.graffiti=Vero+BYOB) on plataberget using this endpoint, without issues, for over a week now.

The most important concern is how this endpoint affects network robustness during suboptimal network conditions (non-finality, reorgs, ...). Validator clients that use this endpoint should make it simple to disable VC-side bid selection, in which case the regular `produceBlockV4` endpoint gets called. Therefore I personally don't think this endpoint makes things much worse during bad network conditions, whereas it does have benefits for multi-node setups during normal conditions.

I would like to discuss [this comment](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8037-state-creation-gas-cost-increase/25694/47) on EIP-8037, which flags that `eth_call` gets a limit of ~16.7M gas for execution gas.

## Reminder: Glamsterdam EIP Status Updates  - `Last Call`

A reminder to Glamsterdam EIP authors and the Hardfork Meta EIP authors to consider updating their proposal Status to Last Call, ahead of the [Sepolia testnet upgrade scheduled this week](https://blog.ethereum.org/2026/09/17/glamsterdam-testnet-announcement).

Current snapshot:

* 26 total proposals (including the Hardfork Meta EIP) → 1 Last Call → 25 still need consideration for Last Call
* 25 EIPs are listed inside [EIP-7773](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7773)
* Already Last Call: 1 -  [EIP-8246](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8246)
* Not Last Call: 24 listed EIPs + EIP-7773 itself

Ideally, all applicable proposals should move to Last Call. We understand that fork preparation takes priority over process updates, and we’ll work to get these PRs reviewed and merged at the earliest.

**For EIP authors**: If you can open the status-change PR, please drop the link in the [next EIP Editing Office Hour agenda](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2242), happening Wednesday (outside the usual schedule). I’ll work with EIP Editors to prioritize these PRs.

If you’d prefer the EIP team to prepare the PR on your behalf and are available to approve it for a quicker merge, please DM me. I’ll prepare the PR and send it to you for your approval and Editor review.

Happy forking! 🎉
